text_size.help: Scales the transcript and the rest of the app together. Per device.

compaction.title: Context compaction
compaction.help: Long sessions are compacted automatically: older turns are summarized so the coworker keeps working instead of running out of context. Your visible transcript is never changed — a small marker shows where compaction happened.
compaction.cap_help: The cap makes very-large-context models compact early — quality and speed degrade well before their nominal limit.
compaction.summarizer_help: The summary is written by this model. The default follows whatever model the session is using.

auto_approve.title: Auto-approve (experimental)
auto_approve.enable_desc: Adds an Auto-approve option to the mode picker. In that mode, your session model reviews each action that would normally need approval and clears the routine ones; anything doubtful still asks you. It can never allow something the rules block. One extra model call per check, billed to your usage.
auto_approve.shadow_desc: On any mode, the reviewer records what it would have decided next to your own choice — without changing anything. Lets you see how it would behave before trusting it. Also costs one model call per approval.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.sub: Where agents run their commands and file tools on this Mac. Applies to every session on this machine; a project cannot change it.

sandbox.provider_direct_desc: Commands run as you, with no limits. Fastest. The default until you choose otherwise.
sandbox.provider_seatbelt_desc: Commands can read and write only the session's folders and reach only the network hosts on the allow list. Your other files and logins are hidden.
sandbox.provider_openshell_desc: One Linux container per agent, with the session's folders mounted. Needs OpenShell and Docker on this machine.
sandbox.refused: Sessions on this machine are refused until this is fixed: {{why}}
sandbox.profile_strict_desc: GitHub, GitLab and the package registries (PyPI, npm, crates, Go).
sandbox.network_help: Shared credentials below add the hosts their tools need.

sandbox.credentials_help: Switched-on entries are copied into every sandbox on this machine for the session, and deleted with it. Your real files are never touched.
sandbox.keychain_note: Logins kept in the macOS Keychain (git over HTTPS) are not files and cannot be shared. Use an SSH remote, or the GitHub connector.
sandbox.does_ssh: Push and pull over SSH, and log in to servers, as you.
sandbox.does_gh: Use gh as you: pull requests, issues, releases.
